title: Captain Penny's Wishing Chest
moral: The best treasure is happiness and sharing wishes.

scenes.summary: Captain Penny finds a map leading to a special treasure chest.
scenes.text: Captain Penny woke up on her ship and found a map showing a treasure on a small island, so she set off with her crew.
scenes.image_prompt: cute pirate captain holding treasure map on ship with friends colorful cartoon style
scenes.story: Captain Penny woke up early on her ship and found a special map showing treasure on an island. She set off with Squeaky and her crew. A storm came, but they stayed brave and worked together. They reached the island and found a shiny chest under a palm tree. Inside were letters with wishes instead of gold. Penny wished for happiness and adventures. Everyone made wishes and felt joyful. They returned home happily, knowing true treasure is kindness and friendship.
